$comment: Per-locale review state, read by shared/i18n and checked by tools/check-catalogs.mjs. A locale seeded by machine translation must be here as reviewed:false; the app refuses to render an unreviewed locale on money-moving and approval screens (docs/specs/i18n.md section 8.4), falling back to English with a visible notice.

en.note: Source of truth. Edited by developers in the same change as the feature.

ru.note: Seeded so the four-form plural path has a real locale to run in, and deliberately left unreviewed: a machine translation of 'you will pay 12,500 rupees' is not something to ship unreviewed to a money screen. Partial on purpose - `complete: false` is what makes I1 report rather than fail, and the missing keys fall back to English per key.
